decoded.meaning: COMPACT{ VALUE label u16=1, VALUE u32=0xDEADBEEF } — one outer frame in the layout a pre-RFC-0032 peer emitted. The code is retired and not reassigned (RFC-0032 §6.1): a codec decodes it structurally as an unknown core-range code and skips it by its declared length.
decoded.note: A receiving node answers one bare ERROR{tr::schema::type_mismatch} on the arrival link and counts it in :stats.router.drops retired_rx. That is behaviour, not codec, so a host test binds it (see description.md).
